T: Find your one thing. Then find the chuckwagon.
D: Three city friends in a midlife crisis sign up for a cattle drive holiday.
P: Serve the mains when the friends take over the cooking on the trail.
S: Curly's one-thing brisket sliders with slaw
Foil-baked brisket shredded in barbecue sauce on slider buns, with slaw

Beef brisket rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, slow-cooked until it pulls apart, piled into soft slider buns with barbecue sauce and a tangy slaw. Rub 1kg beef brisket with 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp garlic powder and salt. Wrap tightly in foil and bake at 150C for 4 hours until it pulls apart. Shred with two forks and stir through 150ml barbecue sauce and the juices. Toss a quarter cabbage, shredded, with 2 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tbsp cider vinegar. Fill 12 slider buns with brisket and slaw.
the first night out on the drive

Buttermilk cornbread baked in a smoking hot cast iron pan until crusty at the edges, cut into wedges and served warm with whipped honey butter. Put a cast iron pan with 20g butter in the oven and heat to 220C. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tbsp sugar and a pinch of salt. Whisk 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter, then stir briefly into the dry mix. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes until golden. Beat 80g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey and serve with the warm wedges.
Mini bagels with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and dill
Mini bagels split and toasted, spread with cream cheese, topped with smoked salmon, capers, thin red onion and dill.
M: Beef chili with dried chilies, tomatoes and kidney beans, skillet cornbread
Beef chuck diced and browned, braised with dried chillies, cumin, garlic, tomato and beans for 3 hours. Cornbread.
Cast iron rib eye with ranch beans

Rib eye seasoned heavily and seared in cast iron, rested, with beans simmered with bacon and molasses and potatoes fried crisp in the steak pan with onion. Fry 150g diced bacon and an onion, add 2 drained cans of cannellini beans, 3 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp mustard and 300ml water and simmer 45 minutes. Parboil 800g potatoes in chunks for 8 minutes. Season 4 rib eye steaks heavily and sear in a smoking cast iron pan for 4 minutes a side, then rest. Fry the potatoes and a sliced onion in the steak fat until crisp.
W: Toasted marshmallow and milk chocolate between digestive cookies

Big marshmallows toasted on sticks over the fire until blistered, sandwiched with a square of milk chocolate between two digestive biscuits and pressed so it melts. Toast 16 big marshmallows on sticks over the fire until blistered. Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 digestive biscuits, 100g chocolate and 32 biscuits in all, and press so it melts.
K: Boiled coffee with cinnamon, topped with brown sugar cream

Coarse coffee boiled with a cinnamon stick in the pot, settled, poured into tin mugs and topped with cold cream whipped with brown sugar and cinnamon. Bring 1.2L water to the boil with a cinnamon stick and stir in 80g coarse ground coffee. Boil 4 minutes, then take off the heat and splash in 100ml cold water to settle the grounds. Whip 150ml cream with 1 tbsp brown sugar and half a tsp ground cinnamon until soft peaks. Pour the coffee carefully into tin mugs, leaving the grounds behind, and top each with a spoon of the cream.
